schema.title: Response List Cameras Api V1 Cameras Get

get.description: Where to watch this camera live. Video comes from the media node, never from here.

get.summary: HLS VOD playlist for a time range (open this URL in VLC)
Browser-compatible AAC audio playlist for a recorded time range

schema.title: Response List Nodes Api V1 Nodes Get

delete.description:
Refused while cameras are assigned. Refused if the node still has recordings in the
catalog unless force=true (which also removes that recordings index). A node that is still
running will register itself again.

schema.title: Response List Volumes Api V1 Nodes  Node Id  Volumes Get

post.summary: Allow the node to record in another folder, drive or network share
post.description:
Added at the end of the fill order. The node checks the folder on its next heartbeat (state
PENDING until then; OK, or ERROR/UNAVAILABLE with the reason). For a network share, save its
credentials on the node PC first (cmdkey) - they are never stored here.

patch.summary: Change a volume's cap or pause it

delete.description:
The node's default folder cannot be removed (pause it instead). Refused while recordings on this
volume are in the catalog unless force=true, which also removes their index (files stay on disk).

schema.title: Response Reorder Volumes Api V1 Nodes  Node Id  Volumes Reorder Post

post.summary: Move all cameras away from this node
Keep current cameras, accept no new ones

schema.title: Response List Assignments Api V1 Assignments Get

put.summary: Manually move a camera to a node

schema.title: Response Assignment History Api V1 Assignments  Camera Id  History Get

post.summary: Find ONVIF cameras on the nodes' LANs

schema.title: Response Discover Api V1 Onvif Discover Post

post.summary: Identity, clock and stream profiles of one device
Preview JPEG of a profile (through the node)
Add a camera from ONVIF: streams filled from its profiles (main recorded, sub live)

get.summary: Live device info, clock and settings (also refreshes the saved device fields)

post.summary: Set the camera clock to the node's time
Point the camera at NTP servers (or the ones DHCP gives)

get.description: Desired state for a node: every camera stream it must pull (and record).

post.description: Per-stream runtime state. Ignored for cameras this node no longer owns.
Idempotent: re-sending the same segment ids is safe.

schema.title: Response Pending Deletions Internal V1 Nodes  Node Id  Deletions Get

post.description: Node confirms files are gone (retention or disk-pressure cleanup).

DriveInfo.title: DriveInfo
DriveInfo.description: A local fixed drive of the node (offered in "Add storage").

codec_note.title: Codec Note
codec_note.default: Codec is passed through from the camera (no transcoding).

VolumeConfig.title: VolumeConfig
VolumeConfig.description: What a node needs to know about one of its volumes (sent in every heartbeat response).

path.title: Path
path.description: A folder on the node: D:\ShahNVR\recordings, \\192.168.1.9\nvr (network share) or /data/nvr

quota_gb.title: Quota Gb
quota_gb.description: Max GB of recordings here; null = whole disk

volume_ids.title: Volume Ids
volume_ids.description: All of the node's volume ids, in fill order

VolumeReport.title: VolumeReport
VolumeReport.description: The node's view of one storage volume.
